title: On Deck
meta_description: On Deck seamlessly blends modern luxury with coastal charm, offering private beach access and everything you need for a memorable beachfront getaway—from tranquil views and stylish comfort to unbeatable proximity to sand, sea, and scenic 30A.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love• Located in Carillon Beach, a private, gated beachfront community• Sweeping Gulf views from multiple levels• 6-seater golf cart and 6 bicycles included• Private heated pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)• Gas grill and outdoor dining space• Professionally designed by Tracery Interiors• Elevator access• Complete clean bedding programWelcome to On Deck, a brand-new luxury retreat polished to perfection with crisp, minimalist design and serene coastal elegance. Nestled within the exclusive gated community of Carillon Beach, this beautiful beach home comfortably accommodates up to eighteen guests and offers an ideal blend of sophistication, spaciousness, and laid-back beachfront living.On the first floor of the main house, a serene bedroom offers a king-size bed and a private ensuite bath. Nearby, a spacious lounge provides the perfect hangout space for children, complete with a large sectional sofa and a TV designed for cozy movie nights or quiet afternoons indoors. There is also a Queen over Queen Bunkbed, and a full guest bathroom is conveniently located next to this area.Upstairs on the second floor, sweeping Gulf views take center stage. Nearly floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors flood the open-concept kitchen, dining, and living space with natural light. The chef’s kitchen features an oversized island with seating for four, while the adjacent dining space offers seating for seven. This floor also features two beautifully appointed king bedrooms, each with a private ensuite bathroom. One of the rooms features a private balcony that overlooks the sparkling pool.The third floor is anchored by the primary suite, where indulgence meets tranquility. A king-size bed, a spa-style ensuite bathroom with a soaking tub that faces the Gulf, and a private balcony with unobstructed views create a peaceful haven for rest and relaxation. Also on this level is a king bedroom with its own ensuite bath and a private balcony with pool views, along with a spacious double queen bedroom with a full ensuite. A full-size laundry room is conveniently located nearby.Between the main house and the carriage house lies a private pool, offering a central outdoor gathering space for sunny days and starlit evenings. The first floor of the carriage house includes a fully equipped kitchen with a central island that seats four, a bright living area with large windows and sliding glass doors, and a half bathroom for added convenience. Upstairs, you’ll find two queen bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom. One of the bedrooms also features a balcony overlooking the pool, adding a quiet, retreat-like feel.HOME LAYOUT: (Sleeps 18)MAIN HOUSE:FIRST FLOOR• King bedroom with ensuite bathroom (Sleeps 2)• Spacious lounge/kids’ area with large sectional and TV—ideal for movie nights or rainy-day fun and a Queen/Queen Bunkbed (Sleeps 4 Kids or 2 Adults) • Full guest bathroomSECOND FLOOR• Bright, open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area with expansive Gulf views • Kitchen island seating for 4 and dining table for 7 • Gulf-facing balcony with outdoor dining for 6, additional lounge seating, and direct beach access stairs • Half bathroom • King bedroom with ensuite bathroom (Sleeps 2) • King bedroom with ensuite bathroom and private balcony overlooking the pool (Sleeps 2)THIRD FLOOR• Primary suite with king bed, luxurious ensuite bath with soaking tub and private Gulf-facing balcony (Sleeps 2)• Bedroom with two queen beds and an ensuite bathroom (Sleeps 4) • King bedroom with ensuite bath and private balcony overlooking the pool (Sleeps 2)• Laundry room with full-size washer and dryerCARRIAGE HOUSE:FIRST FLOOR• Fully equipped kitchen with large island (seats 4)• Open living space with large TV and floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors overlooking the pool • Half bathroomSECOND FLOOR • Two queen bedrooms, each with a private ensuite bath (Sleeps 4) • One bedroom includes a balcony with pool viewsTDT-293802
